value: 1. Patient safety: never miss an emergency. Chest pain etc. gets emergency advice and a nurse alert, never an appointment. Rule-based safety checks sit on top of the AI classifier.
2. Clinical governance: the head nurse signs off the always-emergency list. Every symptom in a child under 2 goes to a nurse. The agent does not decide emergencies alone.
3. Data compliance: patient data stays in-country, and only in-region models are used.

Nurse callback within 1 hour: fever above 39°C for more than 3 days, any symptom in a child under 2, pregnancy with bleeding or pain, severe dehydration.
